personality_one_liner: A highly readable, trustworthy, and practical command center for a phone shop owner, emphasizing clear financial data and structured inventory.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards must not touch screen edges (md margin). Thumb zone rules apply for primary CTAs.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar
Use on sticky headers over scrolling lists (like the inventory)
Use on Floating Action Buttons over a brandTertiary tint
dont's: Never blur list rows, standard cards, or text input fields
Do not use heavily blurred backgrounds for body content

screens.name: Inicio/Caja
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing today's financial summary and quick actions.

states.empty: No transactions today. Show a 'Registrar Venta' or 'Registrar Gasto' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load metrics. Show retry button.

screens.layout: Use a prominent KPI Dashboard at the top: Large text for 'Balance de Hoy' (RD$). Underneath, a 2-column grid for 'Ingresos' and 'Egresos'. Below that, a list of 'Transacciones Recientes' with color-coded amounts (Green for income, Red for expense) and clear action-oriented labels. A floating action button (FAB) or sticky primary CTA for 'Nueva Transacción'.

screens.name: Inventario
screens.purpose: Manage phone stock with photos, status, and IMEI.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty minimal box with 'No hay equipos en inventario. Toca + para agregar.'
states.error: Failed to load inventory. Retry button.

screens.layout: Prominent sticky search bar at the top (Search by IMEI/Model). Below it, a horizontally scrolling filter row (Nuevo, Usado, Reparado). The main list uses a Card layout: Left side image of the phone (expo-image), Right side bold Model name, regular text for IMEI, and a right-aligned bold price. Include color-coded status badges (e.g., green for 'Disponible', red for 'Vendido'). Sticky Add button at the bottom.

screens.name: Reparaciones
screens.purpose: Track repair service statuses and workflow.

states.empty: Illustration of repair tools with text 'No hay reparaciones activas.'

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top to filter status: 'Activas' vs 'Entregadas'. List of cards for each job. Each card must show: Client name, Device Model, Fault (Issue), Cost, and a distinct timeline/progress indicator badge (Recibido, En Progreso, Listo, Entregado) with color-coding (Yellow for progress, Green for ready). Tapping a card opens a bottom sheet to change the status.

screens.name: Más/Reportes
screens.layout: Standard iOS settings grouped list layout. Tinted icon containers for each row. Sections for 'Reporte Mensual', 'Historial de Caja', 'Ajustes de Tienda'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality rigorously: ensure generous padding, clean backgrounds, and avoid unnecessary drop shadows. Let the data speak.

BANNED COLORS: Strictly do not use any shade of blue, purple, indigo, navy, or violet for any UI elements, text, or accents. The primary brand color is Emerald Green (#047857), which symbolizes finance and trustworthiness. Use this color consistently for CTAs, selected tabs, and important highlights.
Implement the 'Inicio/Caja' screen with large, highly legible typography for the cash balance. Ensure currency amounts use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' to stand out.

On the 'Inventario' screen, implement the card layout using 'demo_phone' images from the JSON to make it realistic. Ensure a sticky search bar and horizontal filter row (Nuevo, Usado, Reparado) at the top.

On the 'Reparaciones' screen, cards must have clear, color-coded badges for status (e.g., Recibido: Gray, En Progreso: Yellow/Warning, Listo: BrandPrimary, Entregado: Success). Use bottom sheets for editing the repair status.
Do not use emojis anywhere in the system UI.
Include a scrim layer (linear gradient) on images if text needs to overlay them, though for this app, inventory images will likely be side-by-side with text rather than backgrounds.
Apply iOS native blur using 'expo-glass-effect' for the bottom tab bar and the sticky headers when scrolling.
